Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The prayer in the writ petition is made for direction upon the respondents to pay compensation in respect of land measuring an area of 0.52  acres appertaining to plot no. 1462 under khata 62 in mouza Salaidih in the district of Giridih in the terms of provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is the owner of the land in question.
By way of referring annexure-3 he submits that due is admitted.
4. Learned counsel for the State submits that petitioner may move before the respondent nos. 4 and 5 who will look into the matter.
